page.layout: One column of main text, with a narrow column of marginal notes at the left margin. Running head at the top above the text. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: Verùm qui ense aut ferro ali-
lo, quod est in actu, verùm etiam quod est
in potentiâ, & quidem proximâ, quæ facile
tione, à parte ejus qui resistit,
ut quicquid quis ad salutem cor-
tur. Id autem facimus ad sa-
quod in corpore læsum est, sic re-

marginalia.note: l.3.D.de Just.& jur.l.1.§. vim vi D.de vi &viar-mat.l.1. Cod. Vn/ de vi.

page.notes: Printed notes in the left margin are split at the lines where they stand: the first note block (Wesemb. / Consil. / 19.n.14. / ibid. alii.) stands beside "jure repellitur"; the second block (l.3.D.de Juft.& / jur.l.1.§. / vim vi / D.de vi / &viar- / mat.l.1. / Cod. Vn/ / de vi.) runs down beside lines 11 to 16. Shown as printed, with s read as s and "Juft" as Just. Doubtful: "Vn/" in "Cod. Vn/" may be "Vn." (marked as read); page number "154" where the "1" looks like "r" (marked [?]). The line "re-" at the foot is taken as the catchword, since it stands alone at the right below the last line. Printed "poteft" is read as potest, "fiquidem" as siquidem, "eft" as est, following the rule for long s.
